report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current telemetry contradicts it: gateway traces show one ERROR span while gateway metrics/logs show error_rate 0.001, p95 75ms, status 200; order checkout trace is OK at 1350ms. Order shows retained heap after GC (300MB, 7 WARNs) but no chronological retention series, so a leak is not established. Deployment record alone cannot establish latency causation. Insufficient evidence for a bounded candidate; hand off.
missing_evidence: Traces showing order checkout errors or elevated latency aligned with the alert window
Gateway error-rate/latency metrics corroborating the alert (current gateway metrics show error_rate 0.001, p95 75ms)
Memory-retention time series for order to establish a leak trend rather than a single snapshot
Downstream dependency (inventory, payment, postgresql) latency/error telemetry to rule out downstream-latency
